newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends stronger on poor dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends stronger on poor dlr demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed slightly firmer at 42.8000/8300 to the dollar in a dull, post-holiday interbank session on Wednesday, against a previous close of 42.8100/8300, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.8100/8350 per dollar in early trade. "There were few deals in foreign exchange. The call money market witnessed some activity," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed at 9.5 to 10.5 percent, up from previous at 9.0-9.5 percent.
The interbank market reopened on Wednesday after a three-day Moslem Eid-ul Fitr holiday, dealers said.
